entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options
entities.description: Information element included in messages to transmit security protected protocol data to the network under specific conditions.

entities.name: Protocol configuration options
entities.description: Information element for protocol configuration, mutually exclusive with extended protocol configuration options.

entities.name: UE wishes to transmit security protected protocol data during attach
entities.description: Condition where UE wants to send security protected data like configuration parameters, error codes, or messages/events to the network during attach procedure.

entities.name: UE is in NB-S1 mode
entities.description: Condition indicating the UE is operating in Narrowband S1 mode.

entities.name: Requested PDN Type is non-IP or Ethernet
entities.description: Condition where the requested Packet Data Network type is either non-IP or Ethernet.

entities.name: Requested APN is for UAS services
entities.description: Condition where the requested Access Point Name is designated for Unmanned Aircraft System services.

entities.name: UE supports local IP address in traffic flow aggregate description and TFT filter
entities.description: Condition indicating UE capability for local IP address handling in traffic flow templates.

entities.name: Requested PDN Type is different from non-IP and Ethernet
entities.description: Condition where the requested PDN type is neither non-IP nor Ethernet.

entities.name: Transmit security protected protocol data to network
entities.description: Property describing the transmission of security protected data such as configuration parameters, error codes, or messages/events.

relations.description: Extended protocol configuration options IE is included when UE wishes to transmit security protected protocol data during attach.
Extended protocol configuration options IE is included if UE is in NB-S1 mode and other conditions are met.
Extended protocol configuration options IE is included if requested PDN type is non-IP or Ethernet.
Extended protocol configuration options IE is included if requested APN is for UAS services.
Extended protocol configuration options IE is included if UE supports local IP address in TFT and other conditions are met.
Extended protocol configuration options IE is included if requested PDN type is different from non-IP and Ethernet.
Extended protocol configuration options IE shall not be included if protocol configuration options IE is included.
Condition of transmitting security protected protocol data establishes the property of security protected data transmission.
